Deepen the existing game The checkout contains skill levels and milestones, gathering/training/jobs, combat stances, equipment and crafting, quests/dialogues, locations/travel, weather/time and reputation. The first source and save audit is recorded in `docs/BASELINE_AUDIT.md`; browser smoke testing does not establish full upstream-content coverage. No new race progression is selected. Extend these systems through skill specializations, technique discovery, crafting mastery and material traits, enemy adaptations, faction access and branching quest rewards. Keep ordinary skills useful at later stages: farming can grow alchemical herbs, cooking can support breakthrough preparation, and environmental skills can unlock routes or resources. Each expansion should create an observable choice or interaction, not just another XP bar. ### 2. Several connected forms of progression Proposed character tracks: body conditioning, energy cultivation, soul development and comprehension. Skill mastery can unlock techniques and specializations; equipment mastery can unlock refining, inscriptions and evolving artifacts. Faction standing can unlock mentors, research and facilities. A home or sect can develop gardens, workshops, training grounds and expedition support. Use breakthroughs as gameplay transitions with visible requirements and preparation options. Combine training, materials, discoveries or a trial rather than requiring only a larger number. Provide alternative routes for combat, crafting and exploration builds. Separate travel, ascension and rebirth. Travel changes place without a reset. Ascension opens a higher layer of play. Rebirth is an optional, clearly explained reset with explicitly retained knowledge, discoveries or chosen legacies. Show losses and retained progress before confirmation. Exact retention and balance need playtesting. ### 3. Worlds with different rules These are candidate original settings, not committed names or a claim of implemented content: | World family | Distinct play | Progress it can contribute elsewhere | |---|---|---| | Mortal frontier | Trades, martial schools, survival and local factions | Foundational skills, manuals and contacts | | Cultivation realm | Energy affinities, alchemy, formations and breakthroughs | Techniques, spiritual resources and refining | | Arcane world | Spell research, schools and enchantment | Spell patterns and alternative energy conversions | | Beast wilderness | Ecology, taming and adaptation to habitats | Companions, biological materials and resistances | | Industrial or technological world | Engineering, automation and crafted augmentations | Devices, production knowledge and expedition tools | | Oceanic or sky world | Navigation, pressure or altitude, vehicles and routes | Mobility, rare resources and environmental mastery | | Dream or spirit world | Soul trials, perception and memory | Insights, soul techniques and unusual artifacts | | Ruined or hostile world | Scarcity, hazards and relic expeditions | Recovery expertise and lost technologies | | Higher planes | Synthesis of paths, domain-building and difficult trials | Advanced specializations and new world interactions | Worlds should differ in available energy, hazards, economy, factions, resources, access conditions and rewards. Use shared systems where they fit and world-specific rules where they change decisions. A technological world should not be a cultivation location with renamed enemies. Treat worlds as both branches and tiers: some are alternative destinations at similar strength, others require a breakthrough. Keep visited worlds relevant through recipes, research, relationships and optional challenges. Avoid making every older area mandatory daily upkeep. ### 4. Cross-world interactions Proposed combinations: grow herbs from one world in a researched garden, apply metallurgy to spiritual weapons, combine formations with engineered devices, use navigation mastery on sky routes, and bring spirit insights into spell research. Define compatibility, costs and tradeoffs rather than letting every imported ability dominate every world. Permanent knowledge, maps, recipes, technique familiarity and faction history can form a discovery layer across journeys. Companions and a home base can connect these systems, but should follow the core loop rather than become a separate unfinished game. ### 5. Delivery and acceptance The build baseline and first cultivation review slice were previously verified; that slice is now archived. Current delivery starts from the base adventure and introduces one ordinary expedition with two useful approaches, an observable capability or consequence, and save/reload verification. Keep one realm and one prestige layer as the first expansion scope. Next add a second world with one distinct rule and one useful interaction with the first. This is the acceptance gate for the multi-world design: it changes decisions, gives a reason to revisit the first world, and does not break existing saves. Then add deeper mastery, factions, base development and further worlds in playable increments. UI must explain unlock requirements, modifiers, resource uses and reset consequences. Provide filters and summaries as content grows. Preserve readable progression, offline behavior and recoverable saves. Record implemented, browser-verified and user-reviewed status separately; this document currently describes direction and proposals only. ## Repository Foundation adopted, 2026-10-01: the shared project now uses Miktaew's pinned v0.6 development revision `25afe1a879459d85af609088a046ac4f1d3893e1` plus the ported fork work, on `codex/v06-migration`. The recoverable pre-migration checkpoint is `codex/pre-v06-checkpoint` (`62f100f9975e856517b623c9ba6c568b6d143aac`). [v0.6 migration](docs/V06_MIGRATION.md) owns the source changes, evidence and compatibility limits. Candidate work was verified in the isolated `codex/v06-foundation` worktree before the shared switch. Personal saves were untouched; no remote changes were pushed. Current feature work is on `codex/gameplay-foundations`, based on that adopted foundation. This branch contains the transaction/capability/RNG increment and its rebuilt playable bundle; no remote publication is implied. Fork: https://github.com/onionviolet/yet-another-idle-rpg Upstream: https://github.com/miktaew/yet-another-idle-rpg Keep the MIT license and upstream attribution. Source lives in `src/`, with content in `src/data/`, character/combat models in `src/models/` and shared state components in `src/components/`. The browser loads `dist/bundle.js`. `build.js` uses esbuild. The fork now tracks package.json and package-lock.json with pinned esbuild 0.25.10. Use Node >=22.13, `npm ci`, `npm test`, then `npm run build`. Builds fingerprint JavaScript and CSS URLs to prevent stale previews. Serve the existing game from this folder: ```sh python3 -m http.server 8123 --bind 127.0.0.1 ``` Open http://127.0.0.1:8123 and choose Play for the base adventure. Open the Field journal in Village for the new expedition. Cultivation controls and Jade Hollow are absent. Use a separate fresh origin for tests; do not use personal save exports. Use one game tab per origin and close older builds before reopening that origin. Saving requires browser Web Locks on localhost/HTTPS. A browser without Web Locks opens read-only; do not use a file:// URL. ## Next work Accepted steering, 2026-10-01: return playable content to the existing YAIRPG foundation, remove the added cultivation slice from active gameplay, and retain reusable engine/build improvements and all research. Expand from that base toward the researched worlds, stories, events and run-defining opportunities. This retires the instruction to keep Jade Hollow playable; cultivation remains a possible later path. Current implementation: the v0.6 foundation plus schema5 shared simulation platform, chronicle, Village discoveries/home/services, optional town chapter, independent helpers and the expedition/technique loops. [Shared platform](#shared-engine-platform-requested-and-implemented-2026-10-02) and [engine delivery](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#shared-simulation-platform-2026-10-02) own current services and boundaries; [authoring coverage](docs/ENGINE_AUTHORING.md) maps I01–I39. Jade Hollow remains archived and dormant data stays preserved. Accepted steering, 2026-10-01: implement the transaction and capability foundations and prepare for bloodlines and further RNG mechanics. The source vocabulary supports bloodlines, traits, techniques, conditions, world influences and support; fictional bloodline acquisition/stacking and chance modifiers are tested engine examples. The active demonstration earns an original Field eye trait. This does not select actual bloodlines, inheritance/awakening rules or a complete ability/combat system. Names, prices, odds, rewards and the rope route remain reversible review proposals. Requested steering, 2026-10-01: scope broader groundwork from prior audits, explicitly including shop items. [Engine work packages](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#next-shared-work-packages-requested-2026-10-01) owns the proposed order: acquisition/ownership; knowledge/unlocks/effects; actors/relationships/claims; jobs/facilities/automation; worlds/origins/transitions. The audit families map to those shared contracts rather than independent engines. This request does not select all of their content or change the one-realm/one-prestige milestone. Playable shop increment: Village Basic stock includes three Prepared survey kits and one lightweight Survey rope per ordinary refresh. Native purchase prices start at 8/16 coins, with native Haggling/reputation rules; journal preparation remains fixed at 8/16. Base/resale values are 2/4. The older Coil of rope retains its ID, value and separate role. Existing saved stocks receive new offers at the next scheduled refresh; loading never forcibly refills them. Native trade now uses the staged ownership/acquisition transaction described in [Acquisition increment](#acquisition-increment-2026-10-01). Item labels, prices and stock limits remain review proposals. The earlier sequential-trade statement is preserved in PROTOTYPE_HISTORY.md. Compatibility for this increment: schema1 expansion state migrates additively to schema2 without replaying old commitments or adding new rewards to them. Existing kit counters become real inventory kits once; retired data stays dormant. Older builds reject schema2, so new saves require this fork version. XP that crosses a native skill/recipe/quest unlock is rejected before accepting commitment costs until that unlock has its own transaction adapter. Equipment mutation, arbitrary quest callbacks and health transactions are not yet part of this adapter. The existing item key retains quality/components; this increment consumes or grants inventory items without equipping or evolving them. Native file checkpoint, 2026-10-01: imports validate structure/version/retirement compatibility and pass the real loader in an isolated non-running frame before storage replacement; rejected files retain current saves and show a player message. Export supports Unicode through a marked UTF-8 file format and accepts old unmarked Latin-1 files on import. Failed creation cannot emit an invalid export. Saved reputation is authoritative per region; legacy omissions reconstruct only earned rewards. First-clear unlocks require actual cleared groups, fixing unearned load-time story flags. Seventeen tests and native generated-save file roundtrip/rejection/reload checks pass; exact evidence and limits are in PLAYTEST.md. New exports require the updated fork importer; no upstream roundtrip is implied. Compatibility: `src/save_compatibility.js` moves retired prototype fields and references into versioned `retired_content` entries when loading a prototype save. A character in Jade Hollow returns to Village and its activity pauses; resources, trial/legacy, region/recipe records and removed inventory/storage items stay dormant in the saved payload. Ordinary character progress remains active. This is preservation for future recovery, not automatic restoration into the retired prototype or a supported upstream roundtrip. Personal saves were not read or modified. Requested steering, 2026-10-01: extend the engine to make the audit candidates implementable. This authorizes engine work; it does not accept every research proposal or a final campaign roster. The Village route survey is a reversible original demonstration. Its names, costs, odds and timer remain proposals for review. The earlier [broken crossing rescue](docs/NEXT_EVENT_PROPOSAL.md) remains a separate unselected story option. `docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md` owns runtime contracts, the audit coverage map and remaining architecture; `docs/DIRECTION_SYNTHESIS.md` owns broader creative proposals; `docs/RUN_DEFINING_ADVANTAGES.md` owns the origin comparison. Next gate: Weibao's playable review of the connected Village systems, including shop/service usefulness, Rat-step, the elder chronicle, discovered books/routes/home and the craftsman work/event/routine loop. Broad shared C/D/E services are implemented as described in the engine owner; final power/world catalogues, a full native party-combat conversion, unrestricted dependent-history rollback and an automatic prestige policy remain separate authored work. Browser-closed progression is disabled. No second world or live prestige reset was added. Requested research scope, 2026-10-01: enemy/peer tropes and young-master chains, heaven's chosen and other identities, villain-MC routes, identity/luck stealing and persistent nemesis-style rivals. [Rivals, identities and fate](docs/RIVALS_IDENTITIES_AND_FATE.md) records the current-source audit, bounded source evidence, broad catalogue and original future implementation proposals. This accepts the research scope, not a particular roster, theft rule or runtime implementation. An ordinary recurring-rival dispute is one candidate for the next event; the event itself remains unselected. Requested enemy-protagonist follow-up, 2026-10-01: [Enemy protagonists](docs/ENEMY_PROTAGONISTS.md) compares five books and proposes independent NPC arcs, altered foreknowledge, companion agency, contested opportunities and duties inherited with stolen roles. Its eight arc patterns and three scenarios remain future research candidates; no actor roster, plot, autonomous simulation or new power is selected. Requested concurrency feasibility discussion, 2026-10-01: the [concurrent-character and rogue-clone comparison](docs/ENEMY_PROTAGONISTS.md#concurrent-characters-rogue-clones-and-alternate-modes) distinguishes independent instances, recorded journeys, bounded shared-world actors and larger population simulation. A player/copy/peer scenario is a proposed way to test shared opportunities, independent goals and save ownership. No alternate mode, AI provider, clone origin or runtime implementation is selected; broad autonomy remains an architectural extension beyond the current single-player state. Requested genre research, 2026-10-01: [Progression fantasy tropes and subversions](docs/RESEARCH_GENRE_TROPES.md) records Reddit/Royal Road discussions, author and publisher sources, broader genre directions and original gameplay proposals. Its concrete mechanics and reference shortlist remain unaccepted; the playable milestone is unchanged. Requested broader sweep and trope follow-up, 2026-10-01: [Genre sweep and implementation catalog](docs/RESEARCH_GENRE_SWEEP.md) adds primary-source reference cases, 26 progression families, 30 trope-to-gameplay entries, eight creature relationship models, fourteen scenario seeds and five worked scenarios. It deepens monster bonding, summons, evolution, support, institutions, survival technology and managed sites, with source fit, persistence rules and staged implementation options. These are future candidates; no new power path, plot, roster, reset rule or gameplay implementation is accepted by the research request. Requested upstream comparison, 2026-10-01: [Upstream direction and future adaptation](docs/UPSTREAM_DIRECTION.md) separates Miktaew's hosted v0.5.5.30 releases from the newer v0.6 development source, compares shared NPC/availability/combat work with our plans, and records selective-port versus coordinated-migration options. Town access followed by magic is an explicit future sequence, without a verified delivery date. Use the development source as a comparison before expanding those engine areas; no upstream merge, migration or gameplay selection is accepted by this research request. Verification and limits are recorded in `docs/PLAYTEST.md`. Previous prototype rules, review status and superseded planning are preserved in `docs/PROTOTYPE_HISTORY.md`. Historical save exports in `/Users/weiwei/Downloads/Games/` remain private and untouched. ## Acquisition increment, 2026-10-01 Native trade now stages player/vendor ownership, the current quote, money, market saturation, Haggling XP and the item acquisition log in one envelope before publication. Quotes include current prices and quantities; changes reject for review. Inventory owners are separate from levelable actors. Storage failure leaves staged resources unpublished and pauses saving until reload. The shared acquisition service also handles expedition item costs/grants and acquisition records. No new save schema is needed for these existing domains. Provisional preparation service: after learning anchor points, the Village supplier packs one kit in four game minutes for six coins and awards four Climbing XP. The fee is reserved once; cancellation forfeits it. This is an authored paid service, not a conversion of every native crafting recipe. Generated browser checks verified native purchase and the paid service across Save/reload; human pricing/pacing acceptance is pending. ## Technique increment, 2026-10-01 Provisional original technique: Rat-step, inspired by the movement of Miktaew's existing Starving wolf rat. The authored field-edge observation or a real native combat victory records enemy provenance once. Study costs two coins and three minutes. Practice is separate from owning the ability: internalization becomes available at two proficiency, and execution requires ownership, six proficiency and Agility8. Ownership here means an internalized learned technique; no enemy loses an ability. This movement pattern is our authored invention, not a claim of an existing upstream feint system or a direct book adaptation. Optional active practice costs one coin and offers three untimed decisions, granting one to three proficiency and ten fixed Equilibrium XP per earned point. Slow practice costs no money, takes six game minutes and grants up to two proficiency plus twenty fixed Equilibrium XP. Practice caps at twelve; active patterns, cues, answers, selected draw and reward policy are saved. Each response commits once, and cancellation forfeits the fee without a practice reward. Rat-step opens a three-minute crossing approach that requires no kit or Strength threshold, grants twenty Climbing XP and leaves the crossing unrepaired. It has an85% ready-guide outcome at six proficiency and a guaranteed ready guide at twelve. Native and journal costs/rewards persist before publication. These are reversible lore/balance proposals for review, not an accepted martial roster or a general combat ability system. Expansion schema3 migrates schemas1/2 additively with empty technique records, retaining old jobs, draws, sources and receipts without new rewards. New technique saves require this updated fork. Generated browser checks covered partial active practice, idle practice, internalization and route execution across reload, plus injected failed persistence and native combat evidence. Personal saves remained untouched. ## Enemy-life investigation, 2026-10-02 Requested investigation/preparation completed: [giving enemies life](docs/CHARACTERS_AND_WORLD_EVENTS.md#giving-enemies-life-investigation-2026-10-02) distinguishes disposable monsters, episodic encounters and named actors, with causal off-screen development, scoped information, owned means and lasting outcomes. [Source audit and bounded implementation packet](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#persistent-peer-source-audit-and-implementation-packet-2026-10-02) records what native NPC persistence already supplies, missing life/equipment/encounter/clock adapters, proposed schema4 compatibility and the next concrete action. No enemy-life gameplay or migration is implemented by this pass. Smallest proposed proof: one optional Village route apprentice, cooperation or a nonlethal work-claim contest, one resource-funded independent job and a changed later meeting/settlement. This is a narrower staging variant of the saved storm/title scene; names, balance and exact spar rules remain proposals. Ordinary player defeat keeps fainting/recovery; only eligible authored threats can support lethal outcomes, and historical `total_deaths` never classifies them. All 54 existing tests pass; isolated combat-method probes confirm cleanup/life-flag gaps. New rebuilt browser acceptance is pending and the latest gameplay proof remains 2026-10-01. The current shop/service/Rat-step human-review gate and one-realm/one-prestige milestone stay in place. ## RNG, mechanical difficulty and source-development research, 2026-10-02 Requested research completed: [RNG, encounters and source development](docs/RNG_ENCOUNTERS_AND_SOURCE_DEVELOPMENT.md) audits native/expansion randomness and persistence, distinguishes enemy faculties from controllers/encounters, develops a functional bloodline/source lifecycle, and verifies six bounded book cases plus an official Naruto anime comparator. Exact request provenance is retained in [User vision](docs/USER_VISION.md#rng-enemy-systems-mechanical-difficulty-and-bloodline-research-2026-10-02). References remain comparison candidates; none is automatically a favorite or selected direct setting. Strongest proposed next proof: [one saved nonlethal telegraph/recovery encounter](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#saved-mechanical-encounter-packet-2026-10-02), making native stances, real preparation and earned Rat-step produce distinct counters with a prepared idle policy. Functional source awakening/control can then change its perception/action rules. The existing peer packet retains durable enemy lives. Native combat/crafting/stock RNG adapters, source physiology and these new encounter mechanics remain unimplemented; the current `bloodline` source kind is metadata and tested capability plumbing. This pass changes documentation only, with 54 existing tests passing and latest gameplay browser proof dated 2026-10-01. No lethal rule, source roster, purchase, second realm or additional prestige layer is selected. Current playable human review remains pending. ## Similar-game feature research, 2026-10-02 Requested follow-up completed: [features from similar games and beyond](docs/RESEARCH_IDLE_GAMES.md#features-from-similar-games-and-beyond-2026-10-02) compares thirteen game lineages through primary sources, adds seven close/adjacent references and develops five proposed feature families with concrete interactions, costs and current source dependencies. The strongest next recommendation extends the existing saved encounter packet with a useful technique/equipment choice; discovery, crafting, durable peers and preparation plans remain bounded follow-on candidates. This accepts the requested research scope, not those mechanics, a reference roster or an implementation order. Documentation only; no new gameplay/build/browser/test claim or save change. Current playable review and the one-realm/one-prestige first milestone remain in place. ## Granular interaction research, 2026-10-02 Requested complementary investigation completed: [granular systems and interactions](docs/GRANULAR_SYSTEMS_AND_INTERACTIONS.md) maps the saved ideas through body/conditions, knowledge, materials/logistics, time/access and player-facing correctness, with source evidence, remaining adapters, design questions and revisit triggers. Nine read-only probes identify calendar/access/effect/time inconsistencies; all 54 existing tests still pass. [One earned native formulation packet](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#granular-interaction-audit-and-native-formulation-packet-2026-10-02) proposes an integrated recipe/item/medicine proof, alongside four later candidates. Persistent enemies and RNG/source development retain their separate owners. This is research/scoping, not implemented gameplay or selected balance/lore; fixes, migration and rebuilt browser/human gates remain unperformed. No personal saves, gameplay source or bundle were changed. Current playable review and first milestone remain in place. ## Power scale and distinct world systems, 2026-10-02 Requested clarification/investigation: develop believable lower-level techniques, skill/talent/ability combinations and leveling, inspired by A Death a Day/A Novel Concept and other RR favorites; give the references comparable scope and support different worlds with distinct systems. This accepts the clarification and research scope, not numerical caps, a canonical world roster, a universal power ladder, all proposed fusions or a new implementation order. Exceptional sources and ordinary techniques need their own declared functions/limits; precise examples remain proposals. Shared saves/ownership/time/effect services should preserve local acquisition, growth, combinations and compatibility rules. No new source, schema, build, test or browser gameplay result is claimed. Current playable review and the one-realm/one-prestige first milestone remain in place. Requested further direction, 2026-10-02: simple skills may become extremely powerful through leveling and deep mastery. [Simple-skill growth](docs/RESEARCH_LITRPG_SYSTEMS.md#simple-skills-with-extraordinary-long-term-growth-2026-10-02) owns five original growth patterns and preserves different world systems; [runtime extension](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#long-term-growth-of-simple-skills-2026-10-02) owns growing capacity, level-triggered functions, lineage and curve/save checks. Early modest effects do not establish a permanent ceiling or a universal requirement for a rare bloodline, new named skill or rank replacement. Exact curves, caps, branches and examples remain proposals. Current gameplay, Rat-step proficiency, saves and the first milestone are unchanged; no implementation/browser result is claimed. Requested exploration, 2026-10-02: skill tiers with useful benefits at critical points and varied action-based, RNG-based and other advancement routes. [Tier/route proposals](docs/RESEARCH_LITRPG_SYSTEMS.md#skill-tiers-critical-points-and-advancement-routes-2026-10-02) separates rewards from triggers and preserves five optional development families, small interaction rules and world-specific hybrids; [runtime policy](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#skill-tier-trigger-and-reward-policies-2026-10-02) owns event/XP/function/choice/RNG settlement. Native milestones are existing groundwork; broader tier mechanics and their exact thresholds/chances remain proposed and unimplemented. Current playable review and first milestone stay in place. [Runtime refinement](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#granular-development-refinement-2026-10-02) extends the existing development contracts. Concrete paths, talent branches and growth curves remain proposals; the conversation's stage comparison is illustrative, with no new gameplay or save change. Current playable review and the first milestone remain in place. Requested refinement, 2026-10-02: mastery can extend beyond Advanced into complete command, further refinement and development surpassing a technique's creator or other experts. [Extended mastery and differentiators](docs/RESEARCH_LITRPG_SYSTEMS.md#mastery-beyond-the-creator-rarity-and-other-distinctions-2026-10-02) owns proposed stages, scoped creator/school/frontier achievements, rarity/grade versus potential and other distinctions, with bounded book evidence. [Runtime comparison contract](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#mastery-grades-lineage-and-comparison-contract-2026-10-02) owns implementation. This records the requested breadth, not an accepted universal ladder or rarity table. The illustrative comparison is extended; current gameplay, saves, playable review and first milestone remain in place. Requested decision guidance, 2026-10-02: [choosing advancement policies](docs/RESEARCH_LITRPG_SYSTEMS.md#choosing-an-advancement-policy-2026-10-02) matches the cause and useful benefit to practice, feats, insight, transmission or chance, with player control, world fit, attempt cadence and waiting-time variation considered. Its local Rat-step recommendation and probability illustration remain proposals, not selected universal rules or balance. No gameplay changed; existing playable review and first milestone remain in place. Requested feature exploration, 2026-10-02: people can have their own functional techniques, with incomplete skills/methods, personal development and broader book inspiration including Shadow Slave. [Personal techniques and living traditions](docs/RESEARCH_LITRPG_SYSTEMS.md#personal-techniques-incomplete-methods-and-living-traditions-2026-10-02) owns individual styles, fragments/reconstruction, transmission and lineage, distinguishing method completeness from learner mastery and available means. [Character ownership](docs/CHARACTERS_AND_WORLD_EVENTS.md#personal-techniques-and-teaching-refinement-2026-10-02) and [runtime contract](docs/ENGINE_EXPANSION.md#personal-technique-and-fragment-contract-2026-10-02) own integration. The original Split Reed family is a bounded proof proposal, not a selected roster or implemented feature. Current gameplay/saves, playable review and first milestone remain in place.

## Outcome: distinct complete campaigns with shared working systems

Build the original Frontier deeply and turn the selected source research into substantial local campaigns. A complete campaign has ordinary life, several connected places, viable careers, functional power growth, independent residents/institutions, branching consequential arcs, a mature-stage outcome and reasons to remain or return. Its selected item, ability, origin, interaction and world-rule families must actually operate through native UI and state owners. A room, imported module, impressive catalogue or first quest alone cannot close that goal.

Accepted correction, 2026-10-05: **not every detail has to matter mechanically**. Functional-payoff requirements apply to selected gameplay systems and required mechanics, not every scenic description, casual conversation, ordinary habit, atmospheric object or incidental person. Worlds can include texture, quiet routines and unresolved background without XP, quests, stat changes or an eventual plot reveal. Keep claimed source facts consistent with their edition/era and player knowledge; label original additions. A flavor conversation can remain presentation without a reward, durable relationship flag or fully simulated NPC. If the player relies on a promise, trades stock, teaches a method or uses another selected mechanical service, bind that use to the actual eligible actor and consequence owners then. The finite completion ledger counts required playable paths, functions and outcomes, not mechanically consequential treatment of every book detail.

Two coverage ledgers are needed: **campaign coverage** (places, careers, arcs and aftermath) and **mechanic coverage** (items, sources, powers, institutions, clocks, starts and interactions). Every selected gameplay feature receives an ID, evidence, local use, engine dependency, source/UI owner, status and acceptance case; texture alone does not require a mechanic entry. Representative techniques qualify a family; they do not prove every other selected technique works. Unresolved source facts and unsupported adapters remain visible work, not silently removed requirements.

The feature lists below are expandable examples. New sourced or original mechanisms can be added with an owner, rules, actual function and acceptance case; they are not limited to the first taxonomy. A reviewed milestone still has explicit required IDs so added ideas do not make its completion impossible to assess. Source geography/era and represented campaign coverage are explicit. Distant background does not imply all off-screen people are simulated. ## Depth expansion: geography, resources and connected local lives

Treat a region as a network of purposeful zones: settlement/market, safe or contested gathering ground, wilderness/hunt, battlefield/frontier, ruins/investigation, institution/training ground, workshop/farm/base, restricted or layered area and higher-stage routes. Define terrain, access/ownership, local clock/weather, resources, resident/hostile populations, services, encounters, discovery and links to other places. A zone's label cannot substitute for these functions. Population/resource simulation may be actual local actors, declared bounded aggregates or authored background; promote an aggregate participant to a real stable actor before personal interaction.

Resource chains include location/availability, method/tool/body/source requirements, time/labor, legal custody, actual yield/quality, depletion/regrowth, preservation/storage, refining/crafting, trade and uses in training/projects/care. Hunting, salvaging, farming, mining, fishing, herb gathering and body-bound specimen acquisition have distinct constraints. A resource can support several careers and create institutional/NPC competition. Harvesting cannot create another person's unique organ or an already exported object from a generic repeatable loot row.

Battlefields and wilderness use authored encounter distributions with threat bands, population budgets, eligible sources, group composition, terrain/time/faction conditions and a discovery/contact process. Fixed experts/bosses keep actual strength; ordinary opponents may be drawn within a declared local band. Range can mean encounter-strength range or spatial reach, so specify both. Commit identities/stock once, preserve dead/injured/escaped people, and make scouting, preparation, evasion, pursuit, salvage and negotiation real alternatives where the situation supports them. Avoid automatic player-level matching and repeated rendering draws.

Base development connects site/land/anchor rights, construction stages, real materials/labor, utilities/storage/workstations, residents/permissions, production/training/care, defense and trade routes. Expansion changes capacity and available actions, with authored upkeep/absence policies. Households, guild sites, farms, forts, workshops and pocket refuges can differ. A portable anchor does not automatically export its inhabitants and buildings. Shared storage is actual custody, not a duplicate inventory.

Relationships are directed histories with each person's beliefs, trust/familiarity, preferences, attraction where applicable, obligations, boundaries and independent decisions. Friendship, rivalry, patronage, mentorship, employment, family and optional romance create distinct cooperation/conflict. Romance uses eligible adult characters, actual reciprocal consent and meaningful contexts/choices; gifts/service do not purchase a guaranteed response. Current age/relationship/source-era state matters, including later returns and separation across worlds. Shared homes/projects can join social and production paths without making romance mandatory for progression.

Timelines link occurrence, discovery, local elapsed, subjective experience, life/body/age and outside clock. Progression is a graph of learned methods, source acquisition, practiced control, body/equipment change, knowledge, relationships, facilities and institutional access. Harvest → useful craft → observed help → teaching/access → new function → deeper zone/project → changed local situation is one possible loop. Different worlds need different loops. A source-body change or altered witness can invalidate a later story prerequisite; rereading a menu cannot force the old outcome back into existence.

Preserve its real positive function where supported; do not invent universal equalization. The local Naruto ledger leaves exact transfer costs/lineage exceptions unresolved, so a reduced-regeneration formula is an original prototype proposal until appropriate primary scenes support it.

Model **continuous drain**, **reduced regeneration**, **reduced capacity**, **higher activation cost**, **strain**, **limited suppression/control** and **body/support incompatibility** separately. They change sustainable use, bursts, rest and remedies differently. Source-qualified exceptions and adaptation/training can alter particular conditions; removal/suppression/restoration must undo or restore only the actual corresponding effect. A transplant/theft/loan changes real ownership or installed support and must not duplicate donor execution by accident. A nonlethal victory is not an actual death or an extracted organ.

The same component/effect/provenance approach can represent implanted equipment, living Gu, soul-bound sources, created organisms, inherited organs, stolen artifacts, learned formulas, borrowed powers and combined assemblies. It is a proposed extension of the current body/source/energy/ownership foundations, not an already shipped organ or physiology engine. Inspect existing state owners before choosing record shapes; prefer typed reusable functions with specific local recipes/rules to a separate hardcoded engine for every exceptional ability.

The macro GM must determine the necessary graph of regions/resources/people/projects/progression/timelines and the simulation resolution needed. The micro GM must work through atomic transitions, energy/effect order, identity/custody, target/compatibility, evidence, costs, failure and actual UI consequences. Their reviewed requirements determine the schema/adapter sequence before implementation resumes.

Proposed structure: retain a versioned full reviewed reference bank of source laws/eras/events, places/resources/institutions, people and little items/talents/abilities/recipes. Character authoring can combine occupation/culture/institution/life-stage priors, constrained individual variation, source-defined overrides, personal goals/resources and persistent lived history. Generated choices freeze once and evolve from actual events rather than reroll. | Magical formula/ritual | Obtain attributed instruction → prepare real materials/site → establish eligible source/body/support → acquire control → perform actual function → investigate failure/advance a useful technique |

## Tropes as authored causal structures

Tropes can supply optional situations, character roles and opportunity templates: hidden expert, failed apprentice, contested inheritance, auction, rival sect/team, debt/favor, forbidden experiment, misunderstood help, returning enemy, institution recruitment, unusual bloodline/source and a refuge becoming a community. They are ingredients for an actual local cause.

Each template needs eligible actors/world conditions, private truth, knowledge channels, real means, stakes, distinct responses and later consequences. A hidden expert must actually possess their source/function. An auction transfers finite owned stock. A debt needs accepted terms. A prophecy remains an attributed forecast until its causes occur. Tropes do not force every world into the same story or make canonical outcomes happen after the player removes their prerequisites.

Use fixed source anchors, original authored scenes, actor-driven situations, bounded seeded variants and rare opportunities where each fits. Plot RNG selects a legal prepared situation or actor choice, then commits identity/conditions; it cannot invent causeless betrayal, teleport a resource, or give every resident the player's private knowledge.

Each important character receives a compact context card: source/version/era; identity and present body/role; goals/needs/means; witnessed facts and attributed beliefs; secrets/uncertainties; directed relationships/promises; recent relevant history; temperament/voice cues grounded in selected original scenes; local norms/institutional position; and present occupancy/threat/cost.

Every conversation has a cause, interlocutors, location/time, actual available actions and aftermath. Reaction variants cover witnessed success, partial success, failure, refusal, delay, interruption, hidden intervention, credible disclosure, broken or unaccepted terms and later return. The renderer selects from actual observer knowledge and memories. It cannot reveal author secrets through a cheerful menu line or grant friendship/obligation universally.

For an adapted character, the source GM retrieves relevant contemporary scenes to ground voice, motives, relationships and known powers. Write fresh lines; keep locators and brief analytical cues instead of a raw prose corpus. Original characters use coherent local briefs and demonstrated history. Authored condition-aware dialogue is the default runtime proposal; live LLM narration or personality generation is a separate optional feature requiring its own state/knowledge/cost/recovery design.

## RNG with persistent causes

| RNG use | Eligible variation | Frozen result / boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Starts | Legal role/body/aptitude/traits, finite starting means, authored local cast and opportunities | Seed/profile/revisions/actual identities and owners once; invalid combinations reject before creation |
| Gathering/crafting/research | Source-qualified material quality, discovery, controlled trial results and costs | Commitment/outcome evidence once; a failed experiment may teach a real condition without creating stock |
| Encounters and independent life | Funded actor plans, supported detection, local opportunities, travel/hazard/market conditions | Actual route, time, knowledge and stock; fixed facts stay fixed and missing source is not RNG |
| Rare progression opportunities | Eligible teacher/source/artifact encounter under actual requirements | Ordinary progress remains viable; no mandatory jackpot gate or free unsupported faculty |
| Scenario/dialogue variants | Compatible authored situations and voice variants for the settled context | Variants do not change facts, obligations, identity or rewards on render/reload |

Use current deterministic streams/durable commitment rather than parallel timers or browser randomness. Preview/render consumes no draw. Failed publication leaves original bytes/live state/random progression unchanged. Repeat/revisit settles once through the real claim owner. Loop resets need export conservation and an explicit new-iteration policy; no reload farming of initial rare rewards. Weights/costs remain prototype numbers for human review.

<a id="five-implementation-phases-after-review"></a>

## Five implementation phases for the reviewed world scope

For a selected complete world, these are internal phases of sustained delivery. The bounded skill/discovery wave can proceed now under its packet; the wider phases remain proposed for review. The final integration [DAG](second-pass/integration/IMPLEMENTATION_DAG.json) and [rollout](second-pass/integration/ROLLOUT.md) provide dependency guidance, not expanded authorization.

1. **Freeze scope and contracts.** Confirm roster, source cutoffs, declared campaign coverage, origin/entry/failure/clock defaults and required feature catalogue. Engine publishes actual APIs and a legal example; freeze explicit package activation closure, world/instance/region/layer joins, clock/event order, settlement guards, native write domains, UI consumers and persistent-definition compatibility. New definitions remain inert until explicit activation. Reserve exact files and checkpoints. Preserve held work and known gaps.
2. **Qualify connected foundations.** Integrate Original Frontier and one materially different book-world slice with real items, an acquired usable function, ordinary life, independent actors, causal interaction/context dialogue, seeded commitment and retained aftermath. Repair Short Measure's directed travel and actual start/settlement log checks before its integration. The proposed next distinct route is MoL-compatible cooperative light/control: a supported resident supplies personal mana, light enables real inspection, ordinary daylight handling remains useful, and structure-specific dispel preserves ordinary burning aftermath. This visit remains held. Hard adapters such as loops/bodies/layers receive their own operational cases before broad use. Qualification establishes those exact cases only.
3. **Build worlds and features in parallel.** World GMs implement early/established/mature campaigns; specialists implement missing item/ability/origin/life/interaction primitives and local definitions under frozen interfaces. Existing source GMs retrieve exact evidence and continue full reading. Review actual returned files before widening a repeated worker pattern.
4. **Integrate native play and cross-world behavior.** One shared Engine owner registers real commands/items/sources/regions, binds local state/clock/native UI, composes travel/residence/starts, applies compatible imported powers, and rebuilds. Inspect real output, custody, currencies, effect ordering and divergence across interacting worlds. No module is labelled integrated merely because it imports.
5. **Close campaign and mechanic coverage.** Every required ID maps to working code/UI/state with current evidence; unresolved requirements stay open. Respect the present test deferral, mark built-unverified accurately and retain later generated-save/browser/failure/keyboard and human acceptance gates. When permitted, run the relevant journeys and failures rather than duplicate unrelated full suites.

Suggested first qualification pair for wider world review: repaired Original Frontier Short Measure, then the bounded original MoL-compatible cooperative light/control research visit from the final integration strategy. An eligible resident supplies actual mana; magical illumination and ordinary daylight handling provide distinct useful approaches, and dispel preserves ordinary physical burning aftermath. The pair qualifies these exact shared seams and remains held; it does not close either full campaign. Gu upkeep and Fallout Water Line are later alternatives when their required consumers are selected. No new world visit is authorized by the current skill/discovery exception.

## Historical held work and current dispatch

The following describes the 2026-10-04 held boundary; current 2026-10-05 skill/discovery authorization and receipt supersede it for their named roles only. Before the review-first instruction, Original Frontier was created and Engine/Ability were resumed. No additional runtime implementation chats were created afterward; later explicitly requested planning audits/synthesis chats are recorded separately in RUN. All three received explicit safe-checkpoint-and-wait messages; live thread snapshots subsequently confirmed all three idle/completed with held-state replies. RUN keeps actual observed state; future holds likewise require an actual safe-boundary reply.

[Original held report](../../worlds/original-frontier/REPORT.md) contains a campaign proposal and detached Short Measure module with 26 declarative commands. Syntax/import/definition-registry construction passed before the hold; native/UI registration and gameplay/save proof did not run. Known gaps: its short NPC route conflicts with existing journey timing, and paid inspection lacks a physical-stock reservation/recheck. These must be corrected before that case qualifies. Preserve the useful draft rather than rebuild it from zero.

Engine and Ability safe-boundary replies and saved resume state are recorded in RUN/checkpoint. Pre-review source/module work is retained with its performed checks and limits. Old reports and dispatch requests are history, never permission to bypass the hold.

## Five review decisions

| Decision | Proposed default |
|---|---|
| Campaign roster and depth | Keep all nineteen listed families in the reviewed catalogue, build Original Frontier deeply alongside destinations, and require both campaign and mechanic coverage. Exact late-source/era scope stays explicit |
| Starts and world access | Implement the five driver families as declared supported combinations; preserve the current player and put native-origin lives in separate slots. No automatic protagonist inheritance |
| Time and portability | Freeze unsupported absence/browser-closed time initially; preserve genuine acquired functions where actual support exists; local permissions/currency need explicit issuer/exchange. Select exceptions per world |
| RNG and narrative style | Seed legal starts/opportunities/trials and condition-aware authored scenes; keep basic progression reliable, character knowledge causal and source anchors explicit |
| Failure and release gates | Existing save rules remain; new-world loss/death/rebirth is declared at entry and reviewed. Current extra test suites remain deferred, with built-unverified and later behavior/human gates shown separately |

After Weibao reviews the wider world scope, record accepted decisions/reservations and continue each selected complete-world objective through all required IDs. The selected Frontier code/build objective is delivered with its behavioral/director backlog; skills/discovery retain their delivered foundation. No approval of the nineteen-world roster, Frontier runtime, second prestige, external dependencies or unrelated adapters is inferred. Completed audits remain receipts; no duplicate review/source-reading cascade is needed.
