docs/worlds/LORE_AND_CONTINUITY.md.text:
# Lore, continuity and consequences

Status: Develop/Research proposal, 2026-10-03. Owner: lore/continuity GM, reporting to the master. This dossier owns cross-world source boundaries, parallel histories, identity, causality and evidence rules. It adds no runtime, travel, death policy, save migration or gameplay verification.

Read [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md), [GM role](../gm/LORE_CONTINUITY_GM_PROMPT.md), [campaign framework](CAMPAIGN_FRAMEWORK.md) and [progression/assembly](PROGRESSION_AND_ASSEMBLY.md) first. Local campaigns own people/quests; module catalogues own components/tiers; source ledgers own exact inspected lore. This file supplies constraints and worked consequence patterns without becoming another local content catalogue.

## Authoring recommendation

Use a finished, explicitly bounded work when a stable history matters. It makes the cast, available revelations and known endpoint easier to check. A closed arc in an ongoing universe can serve the same purpose if its dependencies are bounded too. Neither choice makes every setting detail verified or supplies a complete playable campaign.

The useful promise is: **this branch begins from this inspected source snapshot and then follows its own causes**. A source ending establishes what happened in that source history. It does not compel a visitor-altered history to reach that ending. Later publications require a separately reviewed snapshot instead of silently changing an existing instance.

Authoring priority proposal: deepen the five assigned campaigns first; use Naruto and Bleach to test trainable versus body/soul-bound acquisition; keep Invincible as the first comic comparison; reserve Secret Wars for deliberately complex parallel identity; use Watchmen only if bounded investigation is the desired fantasy. This does not select a sixth world or change the first one-realm/one-prestige build milestone.

## Evidence vocabulary

| Mark | Meaning | Permitted claim |
|---|---|---|
| `C` | Inspected primary source or official source-specific explanation | Only the facts and range actually inspected, with locator |
| `A` | Official adaptation corroboration | Evidence about that adaptation; manga compatibility must be checked separately |
| `I` | Inference from bounded evidence | State the reasoning and uncertainty; do not call it a quoted canon rule |
| `O` | Original branch addition or gameplay adaptation | Allowed creative proposal, with its own costs, limits and consequences |
| `U` | Unverified or conflicting claim | Findable question and locator; not a prerequisite advertised as settled canon |

`C` does not mean a whole franchise was audited. A publisher's final-volume page can establish completion without verifying every chapter. An official game manual establishes that game's represented rules, not every metaphysical possibility in its universe. An official merchandise/game announcement is weak corroboration of a named power and cannot establish a complete acquisition rule.

If canon is silent, author a bounded original experiment rather than invent a citation. If canon contradicts the experiment, label a deliberate divergence and identify the changed rule. Avoid disguising a copied franchise power as an ordinary recipe merely because the module template requests eight components.

Keep source paraphrases compact and citations near the claim. Ledgers carry the principal factual summaries; other documents should cite claim IDs instead of repeating pages of synopsis. No source dialogue, manga panels, comic art or game assets are imported by this run.

## Immutable source snapshots

A source snapshot records work, creator/publisher, medium/edition, included range, excluded works, inspected locators, review date, unresolved claims and an author revision. Freeze that revision when an instance is generated. A date of inspection is not an in-world date or a claim about the newest release.

| Assigned family | Frozen working boundary | Owner and exclusions |
|---|---|---|
| Skyrim | Base-game PC manual plus bounded Bethesda core-setting explanations | [Ledger](skyrim/SOURCE_LEDGER.md); no DLC/Creations or exhaustive Elder Scrolls chronology |
| Fallout | Fallout 4 base Commonwealth, official 2287 anchor; 2016 Survival rules as a separately identified mechanics reference | [Ledger](fallout/SOURCE_LEDGER.md); no TV, DLC, Fallout 76 or current-edition additions |
| Elden Ring | 2022 base-game premise and bounded publisher guides, before a selected ending | [Ledger](elden-ring/SOURCE_LEDGER.md); no Shadow of the Erdtree, Nightreign or later-edition additions |
| Naruto | Masashi Kishimoto's original manga volumes 1-72 | [Ledger](naruto/SOURCE_LEDGER.md); anime locators are corroboration, no filler, Boruto, novels or later one-shots by default |
| Bleach | Tite Kubo's original manga volumes 1-74 | [Ledger](bleach/SOURCE_LEDGER.md); anime corroboration does not import new scenes, novels or post-ending additions |

Completion is verified for the original Naruto and Bleach manga in their ledgers. A completed manga can have later related publications; a released game can retain unresolved endings. Neither is a declaration that the franchise stopped publishing forever.

New snapshot procedure: record the added work/range, adjudicate conflicts, propose affected instances and compatible conversion, then let the master select integration. Existing commitments retain their frozen definitions. A new baseline can create a new branch without changing the history of the old one.

## Six distinct continuity promises

| Mode | Promise | Consequence boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Canon-compatible side story | Original people and local events occupy a source-compatible gap | Preserve declared anchors; do not promise the entire unseen world is unchanged |
| Explicit divergence | Begin from checked anchors, then change one event or local rule | Record the first changed cause and re-evaluate every dependent future |
| Earlier independent snapshot | Author an earlier cast/body/institution/resource state | Starts a separate history; no rewind or repair of the active later instance |
| Parallel alternate world | A distinct history has already developed differently | Declare differences at entry; similarity never transfers memories, debts or rank automatically |
| Post-ending continuation | Start after the selected source endpoint | Prior ending remains that instance's past; subsequent events are original unless separately sourced |
| Controlled overlap | Distinct instances can exchange actual people, objects or information | Requires a passage, custody, support and causality contract; no silent merge |

### Canon-compatible side story

Choose a few invariant anchors and their inspected range, such as a village's leadership during a stated chapter window or an institution's existence. Develop original livelihoods, local disputes and expeditions around them. Canonical characters can be absent, busy, reluctant or represented through a dated report. Their schedules need credible means, not convenient omnipresence.

Compatibility is a positive authoring promise, not a hidden rubber wall. If a capable player can materially alter a protected anchor, either declare the action outside this scenario's represented scope before commitment, or transition to explicit divergence when it succeeds. Do not accept a rescue and secretly kill the rescued person solely to preserve a book's future.

Use small invariant sets. Reproducing every off-screen canon event while allowing consequential intervention is an expensive and often contradictory promise. A local story can remain compatible without claiming a full simulation of an entire manga.

### Explicit divergence

Record `baseline revision`, `divergence cause`, `affected actors/assets`, `invalidated expectations`, `new dependencies` and `discovery channels` as proposed author records. The first change may be a rescued person, exposed fraud, acquired technology or denied resource. Distinguish a new historical event from changing a physical/metaphysical rule.

After the change, retain facts unaffected by it. Saving a courier need not abolish a distant war; preserving a leader can materially change orders, recruitment or diplomacy. Recompute dependent choices from actual goals and means. Avoid both universal butterfly-effect invention and a predetermined return to canon.

An enemy may adapt if it learns what happened and can pay for another method. It need not reproduce its canon maneuver with a substitute victim. Failed resources, exposed secrets, deceased agents and lost authority can terminate its plan permanently.

### Earlier independent snapshot

An earlier era is an independently authored start. Name a source-attested chapter/era anchor where available; mark invented dates and local prehistory `O`. Do not copy later ranks, shops, implants, relationships or buildings into it. Check every canonical participant's age/body, affiliation, acquired powers and location.

The snapshot can develop an authored descendant history, but this is a new instance lineage. It cannot refund a destroyed ring, revive a dead teacher or change a workshop already lost in another instance. Historical rollback of a live campaign remains a separate unsupported runtime project.

Two snapshots of one named character represent historical counterparts unless a selected travel rule moves one actual person between them. Counterparts need distinct instance-qualified identity. Exact ages may remain unknown with an explicit age band; never present an invented integer as verified biography.

### Parallel alternate world

Declare both inherited anchors and meaningful differences: leadership, survival, institutional law, resource distribution or power access. A parallel world can have another Kakashi or Rukia; neither shares the first instance's memories by default. A visitor can recognize a face while being a stranger to the counterpart.

Similarity does not imply destiny. A younger counterpart might reject a remembered mentor, take a different job or never obtain the expected power. Conditions that generated a later rival in the baseline can be averted, while a new grievance may create a rival that never existed there.

### Post-ending continuation

Choose precisely where the source ends, including any included epilogue. Starting beyond that point is an original continuation proposal. Establish surviving actors, unresolved obligations, political arrangements, age/body state and power custody from the actual selected endpoint before writing the next crisis.

Do not import a sequel merely because it is official, or silently remove the source epilogue to obtain a convenient cast. A different endpoint or included sequel is a new baseline. Unknown distant history can stay unknown; it does not authorize manufactured canon.

### Controlled overlap

An overlap needs named origin and destination instances, one actual traveler or item, departure/arrival causes, passage limits, memory/body/source retention, return conditions and time policy. Alternate counterparts may coexist only with explicit identities and a reason. Neither gets the other's lineage, bond, account balance or obligations through a shared display name.

If an original person travels, their absence changes their home responsibilities. A counterpart remains at home only if independently instantiated. A summoned projection, copy, corpse, reincarnation and living original are distinct forms with explicit duration, autonomy, source and custody. Observation alone creates none of them.

## Identity and institution checks

For each canonical appearance, record source identity, actual instance ID, era anchor, age/body state, affiliation/rank, powers already acquired, current goal, means, knowledge and commitments. Add checked locators for every consequential claim; a familiar name is not sufficient evidence.

Use an author's identity comparison before combining eras. An adult mentor and their child-era counterpart cannot share a school timetable, organ or debt. A name inherited by a successor is not automatically the same person. An artificial soul/body requires its own source, creation and persistence decision.

Institutions have independent assets, membership, rules, authority and communication. Teaching access, work permits and formal rank differ from combat output. A captain-level fighter need not hold a captain's office; a capable outsider need not be a recognized village shinobi.

When a ruler dies, decide who can issue orders, what succession rules exist and who controls the material means. A surviving clerk may retain records while losing enforcement. A hidden faction cannot magically inherit everybody's knowledge. Leaving a faction can end service rights while retaining learned methods and owned gear.

Local authority belongs to the institution and instance that grants it. Recognition elsewhere needs evidence, an agreement or coercive means. A copied certificate, remembered membership or alternate counterpart cannot confer the original office.

## Knowledge, news and future memory

Keep three owners distinct: actual state, each observer's belief and author-only source expectations. An occurrence can complete before the player discovers it. A report can arrive late, omit details or lie. An NPC can be mistaken without changing what really happened.

A proposed evidence record needs subject and instance, claim, observer, channel, observation time, reported event time, provenance, confidence and contradictions. This is richer than the current runtime's seen/interpreted/understood record; it is not a new exported API or validated save field.

Foreknowledge is a recollection tied to a source/previous instance and believed date. It supplies a lead, such as where to investigate or whom to warn. It does not grant a current map, verified enemy identity, medical diagnosis, faction license or knowledge of another person's private intent.

Useful states: remembered expectation, current observation, corroborated interpretation, disproved prediction and unresolved conflict. Keep the obsolete prediction with its cause rather than deleting the memory when contradicted. Confidence cannot rise merely because the player waited.

Example: a visitor recalls a future attack on a supply depot. Inspection finds different guards and no original cargo. A warning may fund an evacuation; it need not prove an attack exists. The enemy can cancel its plan because the cargo moved. Later news can confirm the cancellation, while an uninformed village still believes an assault is imminent.

Known endings stay in author notes until evidence reveals them. A player menu cannot show a future betrayal, soul identity or hidden hereditary source simply because the author consulted a final-volume synopsis. Tooltips use the actual observer's available evidence.

## Power and acquisition continuity

The [assembly contract](PROGRESSION_AND_ASSEMBLY.md) separates training, structure, quality, condition, source/body, institution and research. Canon stages do not turn those axes into a global numbered tier. Local rank and item rarity are poor substitutes for actual function, fuel, reach and support.

| Acquisition | What can be retained | What cannot be inferred |
|---|---|---|
| Trained technique | Learned pattern, practice history and tested applications | Immediate safe execution in an unsupported body or energy system |
| Observed/copied method | Whatever the actual copying faculty can perceive and encode | The target's organ, lineage, stock, soul bond, authority or every hidden step |
| Bodily source | The actual acquired organ/implant/lineage in its actual body | A free duplicate in a new body or counterpart |
| Soul-bound development | The actual soul's supported acquisition and history | A modular release sold like an interchangeable battery |
| Crafted equipment | One owned object and current condition | Automatic operator mastery, spare materials or a second copy |
| Institution | Granted access, duties and recognized standing | Portable jurisdiction or omniscient collective memory |

Learning a Naruto hand-sign pattern can be useful while chakra control, required nature, actual body/source and technique-specific costs still govern execution. The ledgers separate training, eye acquisition, bloodline and exceptional cases. Copying a puppet motion does not craft its mechanisms or poison. General modern scientific ninja tools are outside the original-manga default boundary unless specifically sourced or declared `O`.

Bleach development must keep the actual spiritual actor, weapon relation, learned methods and institutional support explicit. The [Bleach ledger](bleach/SOURCE_LEDGER.md) supports Bankai and creator/research anchors but leaves precise Shikai/Asauchi formulas and exceptions for chapter inspection. Support equipment, repair work and laboratories can be modular without pretending a workshop manufactures another person's release.

An original cross-world test can investigate compatibility. Name the hypothesized mechanism, actual inputs, safe test conditions, observable result and failure. Success creates a tested branch capability with provenance; it does not rewrite the source series. Failure consumes declared costs while retaining useful evidence.

An effective import can overwhelm lower threats when its real capabilities suffice. Do not add an unsupported immunity to preserve difficulty. Equally, strength alone does not supply a seal's target, a compatible catalyst, a consenting witness or legal office. Distinguish physical inability from institutional refusal.

A variant may simply be superior once its actual acquisition/support exists. Earlier methods can retain a concrete use, become obsolete or be replaced; none needs a manufactured niche. Do not add a fuel, strain, fragility or ethical penalty solely to equalize two abilities. The master's current assembly/ability-family policy preserves this latest steering.

## Transfer and retained history

| Domain | Same-body visit proposal | Alternate-body / soul-entry proposal |
|---|---|---|
| Body | Actual anatomy, wounds, implants and condition travel | New authored body; specify each retained/lost function before entry |
| Methods/memory | Retained learning; execution rechecks support | Retained only under declared policy; memory remains instance-qualified belief |
| Soul/personal bond | Do not duplicate or detach it by a menu action | Explicit soul identity, bonding and body interface required |
| Gear/cargo | One actual holder, object identity and condition | Remains with actual holder unless a real transfer mechanism moves it |
| Companions | Actual person, consent, availability and passage | A counterpart or summoned form is a different authored identity |
| Obligations | Remain attached to actual issuer/history | Another instance does not inherit enforcement automatically |
| Sites/claims | Remain in their actual instance | Earlier/parallel claims have separate causes and custody |

Same-instance reentry preserves the changed people, projects, ownership and unique claims. A later new instance is not a reload trick to reclaim a unique organ or artifact. If repeated counterpart acquisition is deliberately allowed, author finite local costs and explicit campaign uniqueness/aggregation policy rather than hiding it behind travel.

Draft default freezes absent worlds and browser-closed work. A later selected policy can advance funded actor projects on a common clock, with declared limits and discoverable return reports. A story document cannot quietly activate that policy. Current native independent-world and absence-clock adapters remain missing.

No travel preview grants safe escape from every committed danger. An inaccessible gate, dead passage keeper or destroyed return device can prevent return if the selected failure policy supports it. Preserve the cause and give discovery-appropriate evidence; don't silently teleport lost cargo home.

## Consequences have causes

For a material event, define trigger, prerequisites, actual occurrence, assets/actors changed, who detects it, possible responses, immediate costs, downstream dependencies, irreversible losses and later evidence. A timer starts from the initiating occurrence or accepted commitment, not from every later menu visit.

Refusal means the player makes no offered commitment. Other actors may still act and the opportunity may disappear. Default on an accepted obligation is different. Leaving a region does not create a debt merely because an unaccepted mission existed there.

NPCs need goal, current knowledge, finite resources, legal/physical access, method, time and fallback. A rival can study, buy a tool, gather witnesses or seek a sponsor if those means exist. It cannot learn an undisclosed player build from author metadata or conjure an unlimited replacement army.

Track opportunity costs: saving a warehouse can leave insufficient labor to defend a clinic. Supplying one institution may strengthen its rivals' motive to act without guaranteeing a war. A paid service can succeed while the surrounding faction loses. Rewards reflect the accomplished obligation, not a universal happy ending.

### Worked patterns for modified canon anchors

These are original hypothetical branches, not new local quests or verified source alternatives. Exact named-event implementation requires the linked ledger's outstanding chapter checks.

| Pattern and source anchor | Intervention and independent response | Later consequence and evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Naruto: the Kazekage rescue premise, N9 | A visitor's credible warning changes transport or accelerates a rescue. The kidnappers seek another route only if they learn the warning and have agents, custody and time. | A recovered leader changes who can authorize Sand cooperation. Injury, losses and alliance evidence depend on actual rescue. The baseline attack is no longer a compulsory timetable. |
| Naruto: medic training, N6 | A branch preserves an original field medic who would otherwise die during an invented supply raid. The medic takes a hospital post instead of joining the player's party. | More treatment capacity may avert a later patient's grievance and its rival arc. Redirected medicine can create a different grievance among abandoned clients; neither outcome is inevitable. |
| Bleach: Rukia's threatened execution/rescue anchor, B3 | Branch evidence exposes part of the conspiracy early. Officials disagree according to rank, evidence and interest; a conspirator may suppress witnesses or lose the means to proceed. | Avert the execution while retaining an institutional inquiry, damaged trust and unavailable instructors. Do not force the same betrayal scene at a new location merely to recover canon. |
| Skyrim: Whiterun/College/civil conflict anchors, S2 | An original civilian workshop proves a new supply route and refuses exclusive military service. A faction can buy elsewhere or exert pressure through actual local influence. | Civilian stock and College access improve while a military buyer loses capacity. Threats become known through orders, witnesses or damaged shipments, not a global hostility popup. |
| Fallout: maintained armor and settlement anchors, F2 | A negotiated repair keeps an original armored operator alive but transfers gate service rights to a cooperative. The former monopolist funds sabotage only if it retains money and access. | The town gains capacity and an independent political actor; the operator retains personal loyalty, injuries and maintenance needs. Saving a body does not award lifelong obedience. |
| Elden Ring: bell/summoning supports, E2/E5 | A visitor obtains a bell by one inspected route while an original waystation loses its physical monument access. A local supplier can sell information but cannot create another monument by assertion. | Owning the bell and possessing suitable ashes still differs from being able to summon here. A restored route can reopen use; the invented funeral witness rule remains local `O`. |

### Created and averted rivals

A rival arc begins with a person and a grievance/ambition, not a universal hostility meter. An original apprentice loses a funded hospital place after the player reallocates supplies; they first petition, then train with a sponsor if rejected. Witnessed theft can motivate pursuit; an unobserved theft needs a later investigation before blame.

Averted arc: preserve the apprentice's access and credible livelihood, and the revenge motive may never arise. They can still compete for rank for unrelated reasons. Created arc: an imported method makes an established contractor obsolete; the contractor can adapt, bargain or retaliate using retained resources. Competition need not imply murder.

Progression happens through actual paid projects and acquired supports. Success may make a rival much stronger than the player. Failure, death, lost patronage or a resolved grievance can end that arc. Do not respawn the same rivalry under another name because the catalogue expects recurring content.

### Institutions and permanent losses

A destroyed archive can permanently remove its unreproduced contents, witnesses and legal evidence. Copies already made survive in their actual holders' inventories. Reconstructing part of the record is a new project with uncertainty, not a refund of the original loss.

A dead teacher stops future instruction unless an actual sourced or original recovery method succeeds under its declared constraints. Already learned methods remain with students. Institutional succession may preserve routine work while unique expertise, private trust or a personal bond is gone.

An expelled faction member can retain skills and possessions while losing lawful facility access. A seized workshop changes ownership, supply, scheduling and who receives profits. A reinstatement can create new terms without erasing remembered coercion or earlier damage.

No consequence must be repairable. Some can be partly repaired, compensated or replaced while the old loss persists. Repeated collection, travel, reload or counterpart contact cannot settle one claim twice. Recognition and grief remain specific to the people who know the history.

## Defeat, death and continuity

Native defeat and the existing Mara duel retain their current recovery/nonlethal policies. Severe unfairness authorizes design research, not a silent change to old saves. Local defeat, body death, soul persistence, local objective loss, blocked return, run ending and optional prestige are separate questions.

| Event | Required author decision | Forbidden shortcut |
|---|---|---|
| Incapacitation | Who can capture/treat/loot, with what means and cost | Free recovery or universal death inferred from zero HP |
| Body death | Actual body/cargo loss and any sourced recovery | A fresh copy of organs/equipment on reentry |
| Spiritual death/change | Actual soul identity and local metaphysics | Every Bleach visit becoming an extra life |
| Resurrection/reanimation | Specific method, caster, target, materials, costs and resulting form | Turning exceptional canon cases into ordinary renewable crafting |
| Run ending/prestige | Selected losses/retention and explicit entry/commitment disclosure | Every failure becoming the current field-training renewal |

Game respawn mechanics do not prove all local people are immortal. Manga recovery exceptions do not prove a generic transferable resurrection recipe. Ledgers leave exact exceptional methods unresolved until inspected. An earlier counterpart is not a resurrection of the lost person; the player may care about both while their histories remain distinct.

## Bounded comic comparisons

These are source-selection research, not registered worlds. Collection/issue pages establish finite ranges; complete issue-level lore inspection has not occurred. Paths below are authoring proposals, with acquisition claims still needing the indicated primary scenes.

### Invincible, original comic #1-144

`C`: Image identifies #144 as the original series finale in its [final-arc announcement](https://imagecomics.com/press-releases/fan-favorite-superhero-series-comes-to-a-close-in-invincible-finale) and [published final issue](https://imagecomics.com/comics/releases/invincible-144). Freeze the original comic range; exclude television continuity, spin-offs and later related publications unless added as a new snapshot. Completion of this title does not close its entire fictional universe.

Useful foundation: one long finite cast/history can support alternate allegiances and consequential survival, with personal power and institutions in the same campaign. Risk: inheritable/exceptional bodies and overwhelming threats can make a generic training shop false to the premise. Completion evidence supplies no exact genetic, recovery or engineering formula.

Three proposed paths: develop an actually acquired powerful body through training; engineer/maintain a suit or remote platform through research, parts and control; build evacuation, intelligence and supply capacity through an institution. These are distinct acquisition fantasies, not a claim that any ordinary visitor can learn a Viltrumite body or reproduce Robot's capabilities. Exact comic scenes for lineage, Robot's systems and agency authority remain `U`.

### Marvel Secret Wars (2015), core #1-9

`C`: Marvel's [event guide](https://www.marvel.com/comics/guides/508/secret-wars) lists the core issues; its [collection](https://www.marvel.com/comics/collection/54948/secret_wars_trade_paperback) collects #1-9 and separate #0 material, describing a patchwork Battleworld under Doom. Default comparison boundary is core #1-9; #0, prelude runs and tie-ins need separate inclusion. This completed event is not completed Marvel canon. Evidence was available as indexed official-page text; later direct fetches returned 403. This is not an issue-content audit.

Useful foundation: explicit domain boundaries and counterpart identities fit parallel-world questions. Risk: enormous inherited continuity, unique cosmic authority and era-dependent versions make it a harder first adaptation than a self-contained series. The synopsis cannot establish every domain's biology, laws or history.

Three proposed paths: train an actually acquired body/power in a selected domain; maintain technological equipment through a bounded research facility; gain institutional access by domain service, diplomacy or investigation. No cosmic office is an installable module. Marvel's [Armor Wars reading guide](https://www.marvel.com/comics/guides/1971/iron_man_armor_wars) corroborates a separate Technopolis suit-dependent tie-in, but that work is outside the core default and supplies no exact suit recipe here.

### Optional finite contrast: Watchmen (1986), #1-12

`C`: DC's [Deluxe Edition](https://www.dc.com/graphic-novels/watchmen-1986/watchmen-deluxe-edition) collects the original twelve issues; [DC's setting overview](https://www.dc.com/characters/watchmen) describes an alternate political history and an investigation expanding into conspiracy. Exclude Before Watchmen, Doomsday Clock, film/game/TV histories and other later material from this snapshot.

Useful foundation: a compact investigation can make evidence, disclosure and institutional reaction matter more than endlessly climbing damage. Risk: acquiring a singular extraordinary power by routine training would erase that distinction. The finite collection confirms range, not every equipment limit or historical detail.

Three proposed paths: trained investigation/fieldcraft; researched equipment and a supported vehicle/workshop; political or public-information influence through credible evidence and institutions. Nite Owl-style engineering is a proposed source question, not a verified modular recipe; Dr. Manhattan reproduction remains unsupported. This is the finite alternative to inspect if a smaller story audit becomes useful, not an added assignment.

### Complete work versus closed arc

| Criterion | Self-contained completed series | Closed arc in an ongoing universe |
|---|---|---|
| Baseline | Clear original range and endpoint | Core range plus explicit dependency manifest |
| Research load | Long works still require scene-level checks | Short core can hide a much larger inherited-history load |
| Branch freedom | Diverge after a named cause; do not force ending | Diverge locally without silently importing later universe events |
| Progression | Use actual bodies, training and technology present | Must identify which version/person/domain owns each power |
| Later publications | Optional new snapshot | Optional new snapshot, never automatic current-canon merger |

Preferred first comic audit proposal: Invincible for broad bodily/technical/institutional comparison; Watchmen if small causal investigation is the desired contrast. Secret Wars is best reserved for a deliberate overlap scenario once identity and source composition work. No purchase, subscription or new world selection is requested by this priority.

## Review findings and implementation limits

Inspected material: three existing brief/role/packet sets; all five landed campaigns/catalogues for source, body/organ/soul, release/repair, identity/era, import and knowledge constraints; new Naruto/Bleach entry briefs; campaign v1 and evolving assembly v2. They preserve originals, same-instance history, actual sources and missing native isolation. Original builds and sample imports remain proposals; this is a targeted lore review, not complete runtime or line-by-line engineering validation.

| Review item | Observed result | Exact reconciliation owner/gate |
|---|---|---|
| LC1: Naruto taught sealing | The original catalogue statement relied on an excluded one-shot teaching scene. Latest inspected catalogue now narrows N8 to seal-target/life-cost evidence and explicitly makes teaching/acquisition P/U. | Resolved in current prose. NU8 remains a future original-manga source question, not a verified teaching rule. |
| LC2: source IDs | Parallel writers initially assigned different F/E/N/B numbers. Latest catalogue references align Fallout F2/F3, Elden E2/E7/E4, Naruto N6/N7/N11 and Bleach B2/B4/B5/B6/B7. Bleach campaign uses separate publisher P1-P6 tags. | Resolved for inspected primary mappings. Supplemental publisher tags map in the ledgers; master rechecks final revisions to prevent drift. |
| LC3: evidence marks | Campaigns initially used A for original gameplay adaptations; latest inspected drafts now use O. Catalogues explicitly make P an O proposal. | Resolved in inspected revisions; A continues to mean official adaptation corroboration. |
| LC4: mixed live pages | Bethesda introductions include Creations/Anniversary material; Elden pages mix later editions. Writers now explicitly limit them to core paragraphs. | Preserved boundary. Later additions require a new snapshot, not broader reading of the same URL. |
| LC5: official-source gap | Kakashi column's Rin captor attribution is suspect, N10/NU7. No inspected campaign relies on it. Exact manga acquisition/repair exceptions remain N/S/F/E/B U questions. | Future selected scene audit; no invented correction or full-series verification claim. |

Naruto/Bleach implementation packets landed during final review. Their source/eligibility/knowledge/travel and proof-scope sections were inspected: both stage an original local two-route service loop, grant no exceptional source at settlement and explicitly exclude broad source combat or body conversion from the first proof. No additional lore contradiction was found. All five packets now have targeted lore review; their engineering/runtime gates remain unrun.

Existing runtime inspection: [world identity](../../src/world_knowledge.js) and [People](../../src/people_knowledge.js) separate player discovery from registry/private actor data. [Simulation effects](../../src/simulation_effects.js) have directed memories, unique claims and source receipts. Those services do not implement the proposed six continuity modes, soul-entry, counterfactual history, confidence adjudication or independent native worlds.

Design acceptance needs findable source locators, explicit `C/A/I/O/U`, era/identity compatibility, real divergence causes, independent NPC means, stable custody and discovery-separated aftermath. Later gameplay acceptance needs rebuilt enter/intervene/refuse/return/reload behavior on generated saves, with old-save compatibility, failed-save rejection and unique-claim negatives. No such build/browser/save result is claimed here.

## Resume checkpoint

Revision 3, 2026-10-03. Role: lore/continuity specialist, coordinator chat `01a1046a-bc9d-7351-83e1-98dc3cf4af54` is the integrator. Own only this dossier and five SOURCE_LEDGER files. HEAD `97c28efece4fd6248b6f075ad0c6927c3d0432df`; preexisting dirty work preserved. Global reservation is master plus three sibling GM chats; no children spawned, no messaging to other user-visible chats, no runtime/private-save/commit/publish writes.

Inherited framework SHA256 `ccd1e0dd4b4bf98ee77fcbf9c65b2e0ac100063bd6c790b2a2ef9441b001ccd1`; dispatch assembly `1c8f1deb5f320668a1913b6ca9fc294c9c2920bd223a2f991e1db00352d81170`. First live assembly read was master v2, SHA256 `aedfa9920388a1b9b5603e9eaa9d920eaf5b1c494baac13a6a2ef251dc0c4544`. Latest inspected master fingerprints: framework `c1c796a29139284bbeda99d9caf2ad57e8ddd797cb11249eb073d146269550f4`, assembly `35a3ea8aaa3ab4f1336d3617f07c4e7ef5e5287b8dfed4cd7cec7cbc77f37147`; stable composition/body/ownership rules preserved, expanded detail and superior-variant steering reconciled. Role unchanged: `aa52f885096d8f7f4c21267c99d323d65bd39c5b00b411040094d5839e4e574d`.

Progress: six-file research delivery complete. Dossier plus five source ledgers provide immutable baselines, inspected C/A claims, original/inferred rules, findable U questions, causal consequence patterns and bounded comic comparisons. Targeted live sibling review recorded above, including newly landed packets and observed LC1/LC2 corrections. Primary locators were reviewed through fetched pages or indexed official text; Marvel's direct-fetch limitation is explicit. No complete manga/game/comic audit is claimed.

Executed document gate: six actual files, 33 local Markdown targets/anchors checked, no missing links, malformed table rows, trailing whitespace or em dashes; 55 unique primary source URLs indexed. Scoped git whitespace check passed; because these six files are untracked, the direct content scan is the substantive whitespace check. No unit/build/browser/save/migration or human acceptance result. Final owned revisions preserve these conditions.

No tool session, test origin or unknown write outcome. Next action belongs to master: inspect final reserved sibling revisions and the resolved LC1/LC2 findings; keep scene-specific U gaps as later selected-source gates. # Origins, life stages and world timelines

Status: requested design direction and proposed origin contract v2, 2026-10-03. Master GM owner. User requested fresh starts, random families, infancy, tree/nonhuman starts, reincarnation without predecessor powers, other tropes, world timelines and Harry Potter. This adds design owners and source-bounded candidates, not a start selector, new save migration, life reset or forced aging.

Read [campaign composition](CAMPAIGN_FRAMEWORK.md), [continuity](LORE_AND_CONTINUITY.md), [progression/assembly](PROGRESSION_AND_ASSEMBLY.md), [ability families](ABILITY_AUTHORING.md) and the selected world's sources. [Origin GM role](../gm/ORIGIN_SCENARIO_GM_PROMPT.md) supplies future scoped execution. The master authors this run directly; no extra active specialist is required for this design.

## Origin is a composition, not one bonus

| Axis | What it specifies |
|---|---|
| World / source snapshot | Local physical/metaphysical rules and included source range |
| Continuity / era / region | Actual history, dated institutions/people and accessible place |
| Entry route | Native birth, reincarnation, existing-body arrival, summoning, projection, body replacement or other authored passage |
| Body / life stage | Anatomy, senses, mobility, age, health and actual support requirements |
| Mind / memory | Language, old-life recollections, learned methods, mental faculties and uncertainty |
| Source / potential | Acquired/inherited bodily or soul source, dormant potential and control; not universal genre aptitude |
| Family / social role | Particular relationships, recognition, support, duties and access |
| Means / custody | Actual resources, belongings, household-owned goods and available helpers |
| Scenario | Immediate situation, possible actions, stakes, discoveries and aftermath |
| Time / loss | Growth/absence/advancement policy, body/life/run retention and severe-risk terms |

Same world, different starts: an ordinary adult can earn a workshop; a school-age child can earn supervised study; a reincarnated infant can preserve an observation and build a caregiver relationship; a rooted spirit can bargain for protection or irrigation. Their first useful actions differ. A world/era/origin combination is validated, not a random unrestricted product of labels.

### Scratch, birth, reincarnation and replacement

| Scenario family | Retention and starting means | Distinct first play and long arc |
|---|---|---|
| Fresh ordinary start | Local body, authored basic language/means; no prior life or earned imported power | Choose labor, training, craft or a relationship; later access grows from actual work |
| Born into a generated family | Specific household, body/potential and current relations; adult family property stays theirs | Learn habits/places, earn trust/access, choose or reject an expected career |
| Reincarnated baby with memories | Selected recollections/methods remain, while new anatomy and sources are explicit | Observe, signal, develop control and communicate; future knowledge supplies uncertain leads |
| Reincarnated baby without memories | New life with its local support/potential and no hidden player-character knowledge | Discover family/world normally; later source awakening or investigation is not assumed |
| Older transmigrated outsider | Same actual body and declared cargo/sources cross intact | Find shelter, language, work and legitimate access; retain supported earned strength |
| Inhabit an existing body | Declare surviving body physiology, consciousness, memories, belongings and consent/conflict | Learn which functions actually work and who recognizes the body; reconcile inherited duties |
| Take a predecessor's social role | Role/appearance/history are authored; trained methods, sources and authority are separately declared | Survive expectations without unearned techniques; admit incapacity, seek teaching, buy services or investigate |
| Reborn as tree/plant | Rooted body, local senses/growth, support resources and any acquired communication source | Secure water/light/protection, communicate through real channels, research mobility or symbiosis |
| Beast/familiar/construct | Specific body/source/controller/custody and communication abilities | Learn cooperative roles or independence; meaningful anatomy and ownership constraints |
| Projected/dream visitor | Actual remote body/connection, returning domains and interruption defined | Investigate within supported senses/means; no automatic physical loot/body-source transfer |

These are original scenario families. A reference world's lore may permit, prohibit or leave a route unresolved. A deliberately different rule is labelled a branch change. No scenario retroactively edits the user's current save or grants all of a canonical protagonist's power.

## No automatic predecessor-power inheritance

Taking a name, body or narrative role is not identical to possessing the person's techniques, source, mastery, fuel, soul bond, equipment or recognized office. Each domain gets an explicit starting rule. If actual retained anatomy supports an innate faculty, say what survives and whether it is dormant, controllable or unsupported. Do not silently remove an operative organ solely because a challenge needs weakness.

Examples of proposed starts:

- A named ninja's role-only counterpart has their local expectations but no earned technique records. A real eye/lineage, if retained, needs its actual body/source/control contract. An authored source-less counterpart is an explicit variant, not a claim about ordinary canon reincarnation.
- A spiritual worker's remembered sword practice can survive while their original soul-bound release does not. Whether this new soul/body can acquire another source is a local question; knowing a name is not purchasing a Bankai.
- A technician's descendant inherits a family story and possible workshop access. The parent's suit remains one owned object, and the parent's engineering mastery is not in the child's mind.
- A child remembers fictional plot events but starts with no magical body/source. Such memories may guide investigation; the local magic rule determines whether execution can ever be acquired.

Known losses/support are reviewed at origin commitment. Player-facing copy discloses known start means and limitations while preserving hidden family motives/potential. A mode advertised as “no inherited powers” must define whether that means no learned techniques, no bodily faculty, no soul source, no gear, or all of them.

## Generated families and fair representation of unfairness

Generate from source/era-compatible household templates, not a rank-only lottery. Proposed fields: household identity, members/ages/bodies, livelihoods/resources, residence/access, language, social ties, obligations, caregiving means, potential source provenance, known/hidden facts and viable activities. Novel original families can exist beside a source cast without pretending to be canon.

Random generation freezes candidate pool/revision, seed, actual result and acquisition cause once selected. Previewing a profile never rerolls a wealthy family; reload retains the same parents and private history. Future new-origin reroll options need a declared cost/restart policy. No automatic favorable outcome is selected.

A poor supportive household, wealthy restrictive household, isolated caretaker, politically contested lineage or debt-bound apprenticeship changes opportunities and duties. Wealth is not affection, rank is not knowledge, and harshness is not a substitute for authored causes. A difficult start can lack a safe win; terms and actual information still matter.

Household stock belongs to its actual owner/holder. Permission to use a tool can create a loan, not a duplicate item. Parents/guardians have their own work/knowledge/means. They can notice unusual speech or demonstrated talents; they do not know the reincarnator's private memories automatically. A hidden family faculty remains unknown until a supported observation or discovery.

## Infant and child play without long forced waits

An infant's visible options can be attention, observation, recall, simple signaling and supported motor practice. Early wins include a recognized signal, remembered route/voice, a small controlled action, useful trust or a discovered hazard. Adult memories do not supply adult muscle, fluent vocal speech or locally verified facts.

A child phase can open language, literacy, independent movement, chores, apprenticeships and supervised experiments as actual functions develop. Anatomy/control, physical age and retained mental memories are distinct. Exact developmental ages/time and cultural expectations are world-local proposals, not medical guidance or a universal schedule.

Avoid mandatory real-time years of growth. A proposed chapter advance can move to a later phase after meaningful choices. Before acceptance it declares uncompleted work, participating people, calendar changes, body/source development, retained evidence, relevant risks and losses. Its resulting state is frozen and validated, with concrete consequences; it cannot silently mark every future canon event as completed.

Care work can become a consenting NPC controller/routine with actual supplies and capacity. A narrative abstraction can cover unrepresented ordinary days, but must label the scope. It does not prove a full minute-by-minute childhood simulation. Current no-browser-closed-advancement remains; a newborn origin does not introduce offline starvation or aging.

## Tree and other bodies change available actions

A proposed rooted spirit perceives nearby contact, light/water or a declared magical sense. It need not have human eyes/hearing. Ordinary movement is unavailable until an actual mobility faculty, movable vessel, consenting carrier or transplant route is acquired. Root reach and place access are functional, not a cosmetic race modifier.

Progress can include stronger roots, protected bark, supported communication, useful fruit/sap, habitat cooperation, a guardian relationship, a planted grove or a mobile seed/avatar under its own policy. Biological outputs need real support and a declared production rule. The grove is a facility; a seed/avatar does not automatically duplicate the original consciousness/source and possessions.

Interactions include signaling a tending person, lending shelter, sensing a nearby trace, negotiating relocation, protecting a nursery or deciding who receives a scarce output. A visitor may misunderstand the signal. A woodcutter's reaction depends on what they can observe/know and their actual aims. No universal recognition that the tree is secretly the player.

Planting/transplant/symbiosis/graft and body loss need actual custody, survival, source retention and compatibility rules. A human spell's gestures might be unavailable while a compatible learned principle remains useful. Returning to a human body preserves only declared methods/sources, not every plant organ by default.

## Overarching history with local calendars

Represent three author concepts: campaign event ordering, each world's local calendar/era, and the traveler's actual body/experience duration. The runtime still has one authoritative scheduler and durable publication path. Any mapping/local time rate is a selected adapter, not a second unmanaged clock.

Proposed timeline record: world-instance/source revision, local calendar anchor, traveler entry/exit/elapsed exposure, actual event causes, NPC body/life ages, known reports, active commitments and absence policy. Parallel worlds may be in different years or mythic eras while their visits are ordered in one campaign. Similar dates do not merge histories.

An origin can begin before, during, after or alongside a source arc. Earlier versions need earlier people, resources and institutions. Growing from baby to adulthood can overlap real local changes when authored; it does not automatically age frozen absent worlds. A source endpoint is author context, not a character's calendar notification.

Absence alternatives remain proposals: freeze the instance; advance funded relevant actors/events under bounded common-clock work; or author a declared chapter snapshot. Review effects before a time jump that would move a commitment. Repeated preview/import cannot grant retroactive years of production, mastery, inherited wealth or invented missed-deadline loss.

### A worked branching life proposal

An original family lives near a repair/clinic route. In infancy, the reincarnator preserves a heard route warning and learns an intelligible signal. At a later authored child phase, the family can spend scarce funds on literacy, supervised craft or travel; the choice changes who teaches and who owns the household tool. During a regional crisis, the teenager can warn an actual witness, support evacuation, sell unverified future knowledge or abstain.

Saving a supplier may preserve a later training relationship; an ignored warning may prove false in this branch; a planted refuge/grove may support people after the player's departure. Each cause updates only the relevant instance and knowledge. A later reincarnation retains selected memory while body-bound mastery/source/gear follow their declared terms. This is an original coherent arc, not an executed lifespan mechanic.

## Source candidate and implementation gate

[Harry Potter candidate](harry-potter/WORLD_BRIEF.md) develops a bounded school/family/herbology/craft origin reference. Its [source ledger](harry-potter/SOURCE_LEDGER.md) separates the seven novels, bounded companion explanations and original starts. It is outside the five completed deep campaign dossiers; another world GM could expand it under a later exact reservation.

Inspected existing service: `chooseSimulationOrigin` in `src/simulation.js` requires an eligible registered origin and a one-time `origin.selected` claim, then applies staged effects. It is not a new-game body/world initializer, random-family generator, per-life reselection or time-jump engine. Current body primitives and authored NPC lifespan policies likewise do not adapt native player menus/combat to infants or plants.

Missing selected delivery: valid new-game/per-life origin initialization, body-specific legal native actions/stats/inventory, deterministic family/household generation, age/communication/care state, chapter-time projection and safe world-calendar conversion, source/soul/role retention, instance-native bindings and migration/import/UI. Reuse current time/people/custody/knowledge/commands rather than another save or reward manager.

Future gate: fresh ordinary and limited-body origins; legal differing first actions; frozen family/name/resources after reload; no predecessor-power entitlement; one meaningful body/learning milestone with actual cost/knowledge; reviewed chapter advance; preserved original native progress/old-save defaults; rejected invalid/stale/duplicate selection and failed-save publication. Browser proof requires rebuilt source and generated saves on a fresh origin. No such checks run in this design pass.

## Resume checkpoint

Master authored this original contract under current human steering. Exact current owners: this file, origin role, Harry Potter candidate brief/source ledger; other specialist files retain their reservations. No origin-GM chat, leaf worker or runtime write is started by these prompts. Shared interaction/ability GMs can reference these fields; local world details and inspected sources remain their owners. Next: finish HP candidate/source boundaries, review completed specialist designs and integrate local links without claiming origin gameplay.
